data.label: Provision a Stellar grant for a client
Create the client folder in Drive
Copy the blank grant template into the new folder
Link the folder + grant doc onto the client entity

metadata.purpose: Per-client Stellar grant provisioning as an AUTOMATION composing declarative Drive verbs: create a folder named for the client, copy the blank grant template into it (renamed 'stellar grant - {client}'), then link both Drive URLs onto the client entity. Run per client with a manual trigger payload { client, clientEntityId }.
prerequisites: verbs `drive_create_folder` + `drive_copy_file` seeded from the nango-google capability (declarative Drive writes).
a connected Google account (nango-google) — set each capability node's connectionSelector.connectionId (bridge-setup fills this at seed time).

automation.state must carry `clientsFolderId` (the shared 'clients' parent folder — prefilled) and `grantTemplateFileId` (the blank grant template's Drive FILE id — replace the placeholder; find it with drive_search inside the template folder).
the client `profileSlug:'client'` entity should define `grantFolderUrl` + `grantDocUrl` property defs so the entity_update lands cleanly.

trigger payload per run: { client: string, clientEntityId: uuid }. Follow-up (not in this template): an AI fill/judge verb that docs_get the grant, reads other clients' captured grant data for pre-fill, and writes back — governed via checkPermissionOrPropose.
